UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores gamified TKA Lingo learner profile, XP, streak, hearts, gems, mastered units, and detected weak subtopics.

xp.description: Total XP earned across TKA drills and simulations.

gems.description: Earned crystal gems for hints and heart refills.

totalExamsCompleted.description: Number of full 30-question TKA simulations completed.

totalRemedialsCompleted.description: Number of 10-question weakness remedial drills completed.

weakSubtopics.description: List of subtopics identified as weaknesses for remedial practice.

masteredUnits.description: List of completed Duolingo-style skill tree unit IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Stores a completed TKA simulation (30 questions / 75 mins), unit quiz, or 10-question weakness remedial session with weighted IRT score and subtopic diagnostics.

subjectId.description: Identifier of the TKA subject (e.g. mat_wajib, fisika, biosains).

subjectName.description: Display name of the TKA subject.

irtScore.description: Weighted IRT TKA score (0 to 1000) based on question difficulty weights.

correctCount.description: Number of questions answered completely or partially right.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the session.

weakSubtopics.description: Subtopics where the user scored below mastery threshold in this session.

strongSubtopics.description: Subtopics where the user demonstrated high mastery in this session.

aiAnalysisSummary.description: AI diagnostic feedback or study plan summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when attempt was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when attempt was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedCustomQuestion.title: SavedCustomQuestion
SavedCustomQuestion.description: Stores AI-generated or custom remedial TKA questions for a user.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user gamified TKA Lingo profile document.

/users/{userId}/attempts/{attemptId}.description: Per-user history of TKA exam simulations, unit quizzes, and remedial drills.
